import numpy as np
one=np.ones_like(t)
base=[one,x,x**2,1/x,v]
cands={'t':t,'t2':t**2,'1/t':1/t,'log t':np.log(t),'sqrt t':np.sqrt(t),'exp(-t)':np.exp(-t),'sin t':np.sin(t),'cos t':np.cos(t),'sin2t':np.sin(2*t),'cos2t':np.cos(2*t),'t^3':t**3,'exp(t/4)':np.exp(t/4)}
res=[]
for k,f in cands.items():
    A=np.column_stack(base+[f])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    res.append((np.var(dv_dt-A@c)/np.var(dv_dt),k))
res.sort(); print(res)
# pairs
import itertools
best=[]
for (k1,f1),(k2,f2) in itertools.combinations(cands.items(),2):
    A=np.column_stack(base+[f1,f2])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    best.append((np.var(dv_dt-A@c)/np.var(dv_dt),k1,k2))
best.sort(); print(best[:5])
